## s12-v16 — argument map

Fled (palāyitāḥ) yet never unseen (tathāpi nādṛṣṭāḥ): they are always seen by You. Even those who flee are never unseen by the Lord. Fled yet never unseen: the Lord sees even those who flee.

### Open
- Whether 'palāyitāḥ' means 'fled' or 'those who flee' is unresolved.
- Whether 'nādṛṣṭāḥ' means 'never unseen' or 'not unseen' is unresolved.
